description: Hospital Heliports is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. This Hospital Heliport point layer displays California hospital heliport locations with the links to the heliport info sheets that provide permitted approach paths and other information for all the permitted Hospital Heliports in California. The information will be helpful to emergency planners, helicopter operators, and other users. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are California, California Department of Transportation, California State Transportation Agency, CalSTA, Caltrans, CAOpenData, Heliports, Hospital Heliports. The bounding box given is -124.1207,32.4995,-115.4755,41.5415. The hub shows 2023-11-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is a licence or disclaimer text is given on the hub listing (This public data is provided as a service for planning purposes and not intended for design, navigation purposes or airs ...); terms not read in full. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
